versions.subject: Windows Redcannary
versions.detection:
selection_cmdlet:
    - ScriptBlockText|contains: Invoke-DNSExfiltrator
    - ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - ' -i '
        - ' -d '
        - ' -p '
        - ' -doh '
        - ' -t '
condition: selection_cmdlet
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText="*Invoke-DNSExfiltrator*" OR (ScriptBlockText="* -i *" ScriptBlockText="* -d *" ScriptBlockText="* -p *" ScriptBlockText="* -doh *" ScriptBlockText="* -t *")
